test.create_query: CREATE TABLE external_aggregation_hits_mark ENGINE = Memory AS SELECT now64(6) AS t
test.fill_query: SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(c), sum(cityHash64(UserID) * c)) != (SELECT uniqExact(UserID), count(), sum(cityHash64(UserID)) FROM hits_100m_single)) FROM (SELECT UserID, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID) SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 50000000, log_comment = 'external_aggregation_hits.q0'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(c), sum(cityHash64(UserID) * c)) != (SELECT uniqExact(UserID), count(), sum(cityHash64(UserID)) FROM hits_100m_single)) FROM (SELECT UserID, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID) SETTINGS log_comment = 'external_aggregation_hits.q1'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(c), sum(cityHash64(URL) * c)) != (SELECT uniqExact(URL), count(), sum(cityHash64(URL)) FROM hits_100m_single)) FROM (SELECT URL, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY URL) SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 1000000000, log_comment = 'external_aggregation_hits.q2'

SELECT throwIf( (count(), sum(cityHash64(CounterID, RegionID) * s)) != (SELECT uniqExact(CounterID, RegionID), sum(cityHash64(CounterID, RegionID) * ResolutionWidth) FROM hits_100m_single) OR sum(cityHash64(CounterID, RegionID, u)) != ( SELECT sum(cityHash64(CounterID, RegionID, u)) FROM (SELECT CounterID, RegionID, uniq(UserID) AS u FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY CounterID, RegionID SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 0))) FROM (SELECT CounterID, RegionID, uniq(UserID) AS u, sum(ResolutionWidth) AS s FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY CounterID, RegionID) SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 100000000, log_comment = 'external_aggregation_hits.q3'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(c), sum(cityHash64(URL) * c)) != (SELECT uniqExact(URL), count(), sum(cityHash64(URL)) FROM hits_10m_single)) FROM (SELECT URL, count() AS c FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY URL) SETTINGS log_comment = 'external_aggregation_hits.q4'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(c), sum(cityHash64(URL) * c)) != (SELECT uniqExact(URL), count(), sum(cityHash64(URL)) FROM hits_10m_single)) FROM (SELECT URL, count() AS c FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY URL) SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 200000000, log_comment = 'external_aggregation_hits.q5'

SELECT throwIf(groupArray((log_comment, ProfileEvents['ExternalAggregationWritePart'] > 0)) != [ ('external_aggregation_hits.q0', 1), ('external_aggregation_hits.q1', 0), ('external_aggregation_hits.q2', 1), ('external_aggregation_hits.q3', 1), ('external_aggregation_hits.q4', 0), ('external_aggregation_hits.q5', 1)], 'the setup runs of the measured queries are not in query_log, or their spills differ') FROM ( SELECT log_comment, ProfileEvents FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment LIKE 'external_aggregation_hits.q%' AND query_start_time_microseconds >= (SELECT t FROM external_aggregation_hits_mark) ORDER BY event_time_microseconds )
test.query: SELECT UserID, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 50000000
SELECT UserID, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID FORMAT Null

SELECT URL, count() FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY URL FORMAT Null
SELECT URL, count() FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY URL FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 200000000
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS external_aggregation_hits_mark SYNC
